notes: PQ-050.02 leaf closeout. chase_form_v22. Twenty-two chase cycles. Hitch-plus PASS at chase for C22 (play/abeam/close KEEP; TUBE_PADDLE NO; CAGE_READ NO). Parent unproven / not G7. Bake/map MTX rows are not_applicable: this leaf used Principled islands after the texture-density crash lesson. Old cycle/iter reports deleted; final set is chase_form_v22.

rows.notes: Angle bevel then weighted normals on manufactured meshes; hard shade on hull/winglets.

Overlapping dorsal courses and stepped recesses; seams as cuts in a sheet, not extra hoops.
Short thick-root winglets grown from the diamond beam, not paddle lobes.
Thin dark glass in a cage over a cut tub. No solid brick.
Twin nacelle throats with open bells, ceramic heat bands, vanes receding in the bore.
Dorsal cargo well and greenhouse as rimmed holes; cooling fins as separate bodies.
Front and rear guns with bores; RCS and beacons as small hardware.
Lofted service hoses at nacelle, midship, well lips with end fittings.
Clamps, brackets, and hatches only at interfaces, not a rivet carpet.
Bevels applied after transform; hardware uses chase-readable widths.
Unmirrored midship clusters, offset hatches, port/starboard hose paths.
Weighted normals reapplied after booleans; hard shade on manufactured names.
Unique UV0 via smart project on exported meshes. No shared atlas.
No unique bake maps this leaf. Principled islands avoid the 512/4k density trap.
No UV1 tiling detail layer; meso is modeled panels.
